questions.question: She ____ (usually/always) watches TV in the evening, but today she ____ (is watching/ watches) a movie.
They ____ (plan/are planning) to travel to Paris next summer, but they ____ (didn’t book/ didn’t book) their flights yet.
At this time yesterday, she ____ (was reading/read) a book, but now she ____ (is writing/wrote) an essay.
The train ____ (departs/ is departing) at 8:00 AM every morning, but today it ____ (is delayed/ was delayed) due to a strike.
Every morning, he ____ (gets up/ is getting up) at 6:30, but today he ____ (is having breakfast/ had breakfast) later because he overslept.
They ____ (always argue/ are always arguing) about money, but this time they ____ (are fighting/ fought) over a different issue.
She ____ (works/ is working) in a hospital, but last week she ____ (was doing/ did) some volunteer work at an animal shelter.
The concert ____ (starts/ is starting) at 7 PM, but the band ____ (is practicing/ practiced) until 9 PM.
He ____ (never forgets/ is never forgetting) his keys, but yesterday he ____ (forgot/ was forgetting) them again.
While she ____ (cooks/ was cooking) dinner, the phone ____ (rang/ rang) loudly.
